about: The core of Cachet, an open source, self-hosted status page system.

prs.title: The Incidents badge counts every open incident
prs.broken: The dashboard badge counted only incidents guests can see. With an open incident visible only to users, it showed 0 in green while the same page listed it.
prs.changed: The badge now uses the same count as the open incidents card. The public status page is unchanged.
prs.matters: Admins no longer see an all-clear badge while an incident is open.
